# Georgia governor evacuation orders (cited facts from press releases)

- **Source URL(s):** per row in `orders.csv` (governor press releases; WTOC where the release is not online)
- **Fetched:** 2026-10-27
- **License / terms:** Facts extracted from state press releases and news reports; state data cleared by organizer ruling 2026-10-27. Cite the URL; no text copied.
- **Coverage:** Matthew 2016, Irma 2017, Dorian 2019. Not yet: Michael 2018, Idalia 2023, Helene 2024, Milton 2024, Isaias 2026 (Gulf storms had no coastal mandatory order to our knowledge; unverified).
- **Why:** OpenFEMA IPAWS holds no GA coastal evacuation order for these storms.
